[[Joffs the Mitigator]] is a [[Ceratadon]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Riven Earth]].

== Locations ==
* [[Tarnished Coast]]
** {{NPC location|Riven Earth}}

==Quests==
* [[Joffs the Mitigator (Zaishen quest)]]

== Skills ==
16 [[Earth Magic]]
* {{skill icon|Armor of Earth}}
* {{skill icon|Grasping Earth}}
* {{skill icon|Shockwave}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Sliver Armor}}
* {{skill icon|Stoneflesh Aura}}
* {{monster skill icon|Twisting Jaws}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Joffs' Focus]]  ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* He can hit hard, so it is advised to take some [[interrupt]] skills.
* [[Spoil Victor]] and [[Pain Inverter]] are very effective against Joffs. [[List of enchantment removal skills|Enchantment removal]] will also help by removing his protective spells.
* Due to the nature of the [[damage]] from Shockwave, it is advisable to space out your [[party]] as best as you possibly can to avoid a devastating spike which could very well kill your entire party.
* After killing the surrounding enemies, it is possible to lure Joffs to the southeast past a large rock/hill, where he will become stuck as he tries to get back to his spawn. It is then possible to defeat him with minimal casualties as he will simply walk back and forth as you attack him.

==Trivia==
* Joffs may be named after [[Jeff Strain]], one of the three founders of [[ArenaNet]].
* To [http://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/mitigate mitigate] is to lessen damage taken, which is what Joffs defensive spells do.
